Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
for n in list(range(128,5000,1)):
    data=bytearray(os.urandom(n))
    data[0]=9; data[1]=0; data[2]=0; data[3]=1; data[4]=1 # always split
    # last quarter zeros
    q=n//4
    for i in range(n-q,n): data[i]=0
    path='/workspace/cand'
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
    p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/compress_harness',path],stderr=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=2)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print('CRASH n',n,'ret',p.returncode)
        print(p.stderr.decode('latin1')[:3000])
        open('/workspace/poc','wb').write(data)
        break
else:
    print('no crash')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
